s.note: Fried puffed dough with garlic butter, sour cream and grated cheddar
s.how: Mix 500g flour, 7g yeast and 300ml warm water to a soft dough and prove an hour. Stretch into rounds and fry in hot oil until puffed and golden. Brush with butter mixed with crushed garlic, then spread with sour cream and top with grated cheddar.

s.note: Rye crispbreads with crème fraîche, smoked salmon, cucumber and dill
s.how: Spread rye crispbreads with crème fraîche. Top each with folds of smoked salmon, thin cucumber slices and a sprig of dill. Squeeze over a little lemon just before serving, the kind of snack you eat at a safe house in the north.

m.note: Seared pork chops roasted with apples and onions, mashed potatoes, braised cabbage
m.how: Sear 4 pork chops until golden, then add sliced apples and onions to the pan and roast at 200C for 15 minutes. Mash 1kg potatoes with butter. Braise shredded cabbage in a little butter and water until soft. Serve it all on big plates.

w.note: Vanilla cupcakes piped with pastel buttercream and sprinkles
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, then 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Spoon into patty pans and bake at 175C for 18 minutes. Cool and pipe with pastel buttercream made with icing sugar, then cover with sprinkles.

d.n: Red Guardian's black tea with cherry jam
d.note: Strong black tea stirred with strawberry jam, served hot in glasses with lemon
d.how: Brew a strong pot of black tea with 4 tea bags and a litre of boiling water for 5 minutes. Pour into heatproof glasses and stir a spoon of strawberry jam into each. Add a slice of lemon and serve hot, family style.
